qualification: Published v0.4.9 -> v0.4.10 Docker evaluation upgrade with both releases' published bundles, images and launchers, on one Linux arm64 Docker engine, from a fresh v0.4.9 installation (portable lineage 0011-0019). The pair runs no migration: the head stays 0019, so the open transition is not exercised. Logical backup on the same host. Not the published lineage, not off-host recovery, not Kubernetes.

realm_convergence_injection.method: a child group drill-child under the realm's synveda-admins group, created and deleted with kcadm as the convergence administrator from a helper container on the Keycloak management network; while it exists every convergence attempt refuses at its group step
realm_convergence_injection.planted_on: the restored v0.4.9 installation, before each upgrade. The upgrade's own pre-upgrade backups before-0-4-10-retry and before-0-4-10-held therefore contain drill-child in their Keycloak dumps and were not restored; every restore used the pristine before-0-4-10 set
realm_convergence_injection.supervisor_contract: health check every 5 s, 48 retries, 15-minute start period; the launcher waits up to 900 s for health

deviations: The transient-failure watcher's removal failed: the helper ran kcadm in the Keycloak image, which has no awk. The group was removed by hand at 22:14:28, after attempt 4 rather than attempt 1, with the corrected helper. d1-watcher.log holds both the watcher's lines and the manual removal's.

Before the held-failure run, the corrected helper planted, showed and removed drill-child once on the restored v0.4.9 (22:28:39-22:28:52) to prove its removal; the v0.4.9 supervisor, which does not retry, logged nothing new.
